description: Create a prediction: run a model version (version) or an official model (model, as owner/name) with the given input object, and an optional webhook.

input.description: The model's input object, passed through unchanged to the prediction.

model.description: Optional official model to run as 'owner/name'; exactly one of version or model must be given.

version.description: Optional model version ID to run; exactly one of version or model must be given.

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL to notify when the prediction completes.

name: create_prediction
